import os

# Expected vacation spots discovered earlier
spot_names = ['bali','maui','santorini','seoul']
zip_paths = [f"~/pictures/vacations/{name}.zip" for name in spot_names]

# Verify no vacation-spot sub-directories remain
remaining_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/',
    entry_type='directories',
    recursive=False
)
print('remaining_dirs', remaining_dirs)
print('remaining_dirs_count', len(remaining_dirs))

# Verify zip files exist
zip_exists = []
for zp in zip_paths:
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=zp).get('exists')
    zip_exists.append((zp, exists))
print('zip_exists', zip_exists)

# Also list files under vacations (non-recursive) for additional confirmation
vac_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/',
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=False
)
print('vac_files', vac_files)

success_criteria_met = (len(remaining_dirs) == 0) and all(ex for _, ex in zip_exists)
print('success_criteria_met', success_criteria_met)

if success_criteria_met:
    completion = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
    print('completion', completion)
else:
    print('Not completing due to failed criteria.')
